sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "is_reserved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_reserved" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feeds" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_name" TEXT NULL, "group_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "news_enabled" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("news_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "refresh_interval_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "http_etag" TEXT NULL, "http_last_modified" TEXT NULL, "credential_ref" TEXT NULL, "last_checked_at" TEXT NULL, "last_refresh_result" TEXT NULL, "last_refresh_error_kind" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "articles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "feed_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES feeds (id), "feed_title" TEXT NULL, "feed_url" TEXT NULL, "guid" TEXT NULL, "guid_present" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("guid_present" IN (0, 1)), "normalized_link" TEXT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NULL, "fallback_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "sync_key" TEXT NULL, "fingerprint_reliability" TEXT NULL, "identity_basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "published_at" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "body" TEXT NULL, "body_completeness" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (body_completeness IN ('sourceBody', 'summaryOnly', 'extracted', 'unknown')), "body_hash" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, "extracted_body" TEXT NULL, "extracted_body_hash" TEXT NULL, "extracted_at" TEXT NULL, "extracted_title" TEXT NULL, "ai_summary" TEXT NULL, "ai_summary_at" TEXT NULL, "ai_summary_model" TEXT NULL, "extracted_image_urls" TEXT NULL, "reading_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unread' CHECK (reading_state IN ('unread', 'read', 'later')), "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "articles_fts" USING fts5(title, author, summary, body, content='articles', content_rowid='id', tokenize='trigram');
CREATE TRIGGER articles_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON articles BEGIN INSERT INTO articles_fts ("rowid", title, author, summary, body) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.author, new.summary, new.body);END

CREATE TRIGGER articles_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON articles BEGIN INSERT INTO articles_fts (articles_fts, "rowid", title, author, summary, body) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.author, old.summary, old.body);END

CREATE TRIGGER articles_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF title, author, summary, body ON articles BEGIN INSERT INTO articles_fts (articles_fts, "rowid", title, author, summary, body) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.author, old.summary, old.body);INSERT INTO articles_fts ("rowid", title, author, summary, body) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.author, new.summary, new.body);END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_articles_feed_guid ON articles (feed_id, guid) WHERE guid IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_articles_feed_normalized_link ON articles (feed_id, normalized_link) WHERE normalized_link IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_articles_feed_fingerprint ON articles (feed_id, fallback_fingerprint) WHERE fallback_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_articles_feed_published ON articles (feed_id, published_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_articles_reading_state ON articles (reading_state)
CREATE INDEX ix_articles_favorite ON articles (favorite)
CREATE INDEX ix_articles_body_hash ON articles (body_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_articles_sync_key ON articles (sync_key) WHERE sync_key IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_groups_sync_id ON "groups" (sync_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_feeds_sync_id ON feeds (sync_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_feeds_normalized_url ON feeds (normalized_url)
CREATE INDEX ix_feeds_group_sort ON feeds (group_id, sort_order)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deletion_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "keep_favorites" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("keep_favorites" IN (0, 1)), "deleted_article_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kept_favorite_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "article_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES articles (id), "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "effective_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "summary_versions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_snapshot_ref" TEXT NULL, "input_snapshot_hash" TEXT NULL, "provider_alias" TEXT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NULL, "task_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_current" IN (0, 1)), "content" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CHECK (is_current = 0 OR task_status IN ('succeeded', 'partial')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "citations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "summary_version_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES summary_versions (id), "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" TEXT NULL, "accessed_at" TEXT NULL, "excerpt" TEXT NOT NULL, "material_hash" TEXT NULL, "access_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "article_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES articles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_model_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "preset" TEXT NULL, "protocol_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "capability_text" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("capability_text" IN (0, 1)), "capability_vision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("capability_vision" IN (0, 1)), "capability_streaming" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("capability_streaming" IN (0, 1)), "capability_tools" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("capability_tools" IN (0, 1)), "capability_structured" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("capability_structured" IN (0, 1)), "context_window" INTEGER NULL, "output_budget" INTEGER NULL, "is_default_for_tasks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default_for_tasks" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_tasks" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "prompt_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_aliases" TEXT NOT NULL, "route_model_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "deadline" TEXT NULL, "consumed_tokens" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "result_text" TEXT NULL, "finish_reason" TEXT NULL, "error_kind" TEXT NULL, "provider_alias" TEXT NULL, "cache_key" TEXT NULL, "from_cache" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("from_cache" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_result_cache_records" ("cache_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cache_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_service_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "max_results" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "timeout_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "allow_private_endpoint" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_private_endpoint" IN (0, 1)), "is_default_for_tasks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default_for_tasks" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "article_translation_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "article_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES articles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_language" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_length" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "model_label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "translation_segment_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "translation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES article_translation_records (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "segment_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "block_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "translated_text" TEXT NULL, "source_truncated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("source_truncated" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "news_required_site_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "news_config_entry_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "news_prompt_version_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "language" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_instruction" TEXT NOT NULL, "output_spec" TEXT NOT NULL, "advanced_prompt" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "news_runs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "task_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_results" TEXT NOT NULL, "materials" TEXT NOT NULL, "items" TEXT NOT NULL, "draft_text" TEXT NULL, "provider_alias" TEXT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NULL, "consumed_tokens" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_kind" TEXT NULL, "stage" TEXT NULL, "verification_method" TEXT NULL, "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_current" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (is_current = 0 OR task_status IN ('succeeded', 'partial')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_version" TEXT NULL, "local_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" TEXT NULL, "device_name" TEXT NULL, "supports_conditional_write" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("supports_conditional_write" IN (0, 1)), "capability_probed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_pending_changes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_tombstones" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_feed_alias_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_feed_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES feeds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));
CREATE INDEX ix_deletion_events_sync_id ON deletion_events (sync_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_deletion_events_deleted_at ON deletion_events (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_reading_sessions_article_start ON reading_sessions (article_id, started_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_reading_sessions_started ON reading_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_summary_versions_local_date ON summary_versions (local_date, time_zone)
CREATE INDEX ix_citations_summary ON citations (summary_version_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_citations_source ON citations (source_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_settings_updated_at ON settings (updated_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_ai_models_alias ON ai_model_records (alias)
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_models_sort ON ai_model_records (sort_order)
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_tasks_created ON ai_tasks (created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_tasks_status ON ai_tasks (status)
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_result_cache_created ON ai_result_cache_records (created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_search_service_label ON search_service_records (label)
CREATE INDEX ix_search_service_sort ON search_service_records (sort_order)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_translations_article_language ON article_translation_records (article_id, target_language)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_translation_segments_translation_index ON translation_segment_records (translation_id, segment_index)
CREATE INDEX ix_news_required_sites_order ON news_required_site_records (sort_order)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_news_config_entries_kind_order ON news_config_entry_records (kind, sort_order)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_news_prompt_versions_language_version ON news_prompt_version_records (language, version)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_news_runs_date_tz_version ON news_runs (local_date, time_zone, version)
CREATE INDEX ix_news_runs_local_date ON news_runs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX ix_news_runs_current ON news_runs (local_date, time_zone, is_current)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_sync_pending_entity_field ON sync_pending_changes (entity_kind, entity_key, field_name)
CREATE INDEX ix_sync_pending_revision ON sync_pending_changes (revision)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_sync_tombstones_entity ON sync_tombstones (entity_kind, entity_key)
CREATE INDEX ix_sync_tombstones_at ON sync_tombstones (deleted_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_sync_feed_aliases_local ON sync_feed_alias_records (local_feed_id, sync_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_sync_feed_aliases_sync_id ON sync_feed_alias_records (sync_id)
